units.text: Normally this option affects only lines that are completely empty, but if you also specify an option that ignores trailing spaces, lines are also affected if they look empty but contain white space. In other words, ⟦0⟧ is equivalent to ‘⟦1⟧’ by default, but it is equivalent to ⟦2⟧ if ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧ or ⟦5⟧ is also specified.
units.sourceHTML: Normally this option affects only lines that are completely empty, but if you also specify an option that ignores trailing spaces, lines are also affected if they look empty but contain white space. In other words, -B is equivalent to ‘-I '^$'’ by default, but it is equivalent to -I '^[[:space:]]*$' if -b, -w or -Z is also specified.
